intro: Applebee's is an American casual-dining chain known for its wide neighborhood grill menu, from burgers and riblets to pasta, steaks and big value deals. Most guests come for the 2 for $25 and All You Can Eat offers, which make it one of the better-value sit-down options. Below is the full Applebee's menu with prices and calories for 2026, broken down by category.
quick_answer: The Classic Burger with fries is around $13.19, and most entrees run $15 to $27. Applebee's two-person 2 for $25 deal includes a full appetizer and two entrees, and the limited-time All You Can Eat boneless wings, riblets or shrimp with endless fries is about $15.99. Kids meals are around $7.79.
hot_deal: Applebee's runs two big value deals: the 2 for $25 (a full appetizer plus two entrees for two people) and, for a limited time, All You Can Eat boneless wings, riblets or double crunch shrimp with endless fries for around $15.99, dine-in only. Deals and prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is the Applebee's 2 for $25 deal?
faqs.a: The 2 for $25 is Applebee's two-person deal: one full-size appetizer to share plus two full entrees chosen from a set list. The exact price and choices vary by location and promotion, and it is one of the best values on the menu.

faqs.q: Does Applebee's have an All You Can Eat deal?
faqs.a: Yes. Applebee's often runs a limited-time All You Can Eat offer, around $15.99, with unlimited boneless wings, riblets or double crunch shrimp plus endless fries. It is dine-in only and availability varies by location.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Applebee's?
faqs.a: The best known are the Boneless Wings, Fiesta Lime Chicken, the signature riblets, the Oriental Chicken Salad, and the Triple Chocolate Meltdown dessert.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest meal at Applebee's?
faqs.a: The Classic Burger with fries is one of the cheapest full meals at around $13.19, and the 2 for $25 deal is the best value for two people. Kids meals are about $7.79.

faqs.q: Does Applebee's have a happy hour?
faqs.a: Many Applebee's locations run a Dollaritas and late-night happy hour with discounted drinks and appetizers, usually on weekday afternoons and evenings. Offers and times vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Applebee's have a lunch menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Many locations offer lunch combos and smaller lunch portions at lower prices during weekday lunch hours.
